Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-05 Chimica organica

item.description:

Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-01 Chimica analitica, ambientale e dei beni culturali

The research activity will focus on the development and characterization of biomimetic and edible nanozymes with catalytic activity toward glucose oxidation, to be integrated into electrochemical platforms for its ultrasensitive and selective determination. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Novel Photocatalytic Strategies for Organoboron Chemistry - 2026_IDR_DCMC_22 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-06 Fondamenti chimici delle tecnologie

The project aims to develop innovative photocatalytic strategies for the sustainable synthesis of organoboron compounds (OBCs), fundamental in organic chemistry and crucial for the pharmaceutical and materials sectors. Since traditional methods based on carbanion chemistry are poorly sustainable, an efficient and eco-compatible approach driven by visible light is proposed. Photocatalysis grants access to open-shell intermediates under mild conditions, a reactivity suited to boron substrates, whose vacant p orbital favours radical stabilisation. Its core is the biomimetic design of the photocatalyst: natural photoactive cofactors will serve as templates for synthetic catalysts reproducing…

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Recovery and/or upcycling of organic material from rechargeable battery electrodes using non-conventional sustainable solvents (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-05 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-06 Fondamenti chimici delle tecnologie

Recovery and/or upcycling of organic material from rechargeable battery electrodes using non‑conventional sustainable solvents aims to establish low‑impact processes for selectively extracting, purifying, and revalorizing polymeric binders, conductive additives, and organic degradation products from spent electrodes. The project will design tailored deep eutectic solvents and maximize solubilization efficiency while preserving molecular integrity. Advanced spectroscopic analysis and electrochemical characterization will guide optimization of extraction pathways. Recovered organics will be transformed into functional precursors for new electrode formulations or carbonaceous materials,…

The project will focus on the study of the effects induced by exposure to environmental contaminants in complex biological systems, with the aim of understanding the cellular and molecular mechanisms associated with the risk of chronic diseases. The activities will include sample preparation and treatment, the analysis of biological responses under different experimental conditions, and the evaluation of biochemical and metabolic alterations induced by exposure.
